statement: A T-Square's 'empty leg' — the point directly opposite the apex, which the pattern's built-in tension doesn't automatically develop — happens to share a sign with another placement elsewhere in the chart. That's not automatic (most T-squares have no such match): when it happens, the deliberate integration work the T-square calls for is pointed at a specific, otherwise-unrelated part of the chart, rather than staying an abstract missing quality with nowhere concrete to land.
editorial_note: Same-SIGN coincidence, not a tight-orb conjunction at the exact empty-leg degree — a body sitting exactly at that degree would already register as a Grand Cross via the existing aspect-pattern detection, which this is deliberately distinct from and complementary to.
